description: Run objects, CLAR version 1, with the value each holds: the writer's block size and Bloom bits per key, the reference condition, and each section's partition, hash count, block count, and rows in order. Decoding the bytes yields the value, and, where encoded is true, the writer encodes the value as the bytes.

cases.name: A drain of ledger 3 from slot 0: one section over the whole keyspace with one row, at the default settings.

A drain of ledger 3 from slot 812 into partition 0011/4 in 64-byte blocks: a key whose rows span blocks, so the second block continues the first, a row longer than the block size in a block of its own, a Replace and a Delete, and empty payloads.

A compaction output of two sections, the children 0/1 and 1/1 of the whole keyspace, from inputs of three objects, one with a name of 200 characters and one at offset 2^63 - 1, with one row per block (block size 1) and 1 bit per key; its rows span ledgers 9 and 10.
A drain of ledger 7 at 64 bits per key, the most a writer takes: 44 hashes per key.
Two rows which fill a block of exactly 68 bytes, the block size, in one block.
The same two rows under a block size of 67, one byte short of both, in two blocks.
The largest values: a key of 65,535 bytes in a partition of its full 524,280 bits, the key as its prefix; a tag of ledger 2^64 - 1, slot 2^63 - 2, and index 2^31 - 1; and a drain from that slot.
A filter recording 3 hashes at 14 bits per key, where the writer records 10: the decoder takes the recorded count.
A filter recording 64 hashes, the most the format records, which no writer setting gives.
